cues: Generic comprehensive template structure: architecture diagram, capabilities, roadmap, config, success criteria, with no stated assumptions or open questions
Emoji checkmarks and a cheerleading closing line ('robust, safe, and effective!') suggest default unstructured model output
Fixed week-based roadmap (Weeks 1-8) and vanity success metrics (90% satisfaction, 30% velocity) with no justification or baseline
No explicit risks/unknowns section, no verification steps for the plan itself, no clarifying scope decisions or tradeoff discussion
Internal inconsistency: auto-resolve limited to docs/typo/config in the config, but the decision matrix allows bug and feature auto-fix, and nothing reconciles the two
